accuracy.description: How specific the specification must be before a gap counts as closed, from 1 (broad intent) to 10 (exact, verifiable behaviour). Defaults to 5.

curiosity.description: How far the interview follows the ramifications of each answer, from 1 (face value) to 10 (every ramification). Defaults to 4.

bishSession.description: Opaque continuation token for the Interview Loop's one continuing agent session; shape is adapter-defined (see specs/adapters.md). Named distinctly from other phases since only `bish` uses it.
